about: Box-track diffusion weights for assets/js/demos/boxtrack.js, from the Box Track Diffusion artifact (trained offline: 30,000 steps on 500,000 synthetic tracks, 200-2000 m, conformal calibration of the regions on 400 separate tracks). eval: written by tools/eval_boxtrack.mjs.

protocol.error: distance between predicted (sample mean) and true box centre at 1.2 s, converted to metres at the true range
